title: Whafful's Autumn Leaves
description: Changes select leaf blocks to have autumn colors.
body:
This resource pack retextures various leaf blocks to have the upcoming poplar leaf textures, allowing players to play with the new 26.3 block sets before they're officially available.


![Poplar Leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b466d0b2c5715643586ab08193d664ff68edc158.png)

Retextures the following leaf blocks to have the following poplar leaf textures:

Cherry Leaves -> Yellow

Flowering Azalea Leaves -> Orange

Pale Oak Leaves -> Red


Disclaimer:
These textures were recreated by me based on screenshots and previews of upcoming Minecraft content. While the textures themselves are my own work, they are closely based on designs originally created by Mojang Studios, and I do not claim ownership of the underlying block designs or concepts. This project is an unofficial fan-made resource pack and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
